windows.name: Windows
windows.description: The desktop browser for Windows x64. Choose the installer for automatic updates, or portable for a standalone launcher.

mac.name: Mac
mac.description: A desktop build for Intel and Apple silicon is configured. Downloads appear when a signed Mac release is published.

linux.name: Linux
linux.description: AppImage and DEB builds are configured for Linux x64. The download appears when a Linux release is published.

ios.name: iOS
ios.description: A native Nivora browser for iPhone and iPad is planned. The optional web companion is separate from a native iOS app.

android.name: Android
android.description: A native Nivora browser for Android is planned. There is no APK or Play Store release available yet.
